record.question: The difference between two stage bidding and two bid system is:
options: Two-Stage Bidding is mandatory for all consultancy contracts, while the Two-Bid System is used for procurement of major works
In two-stage bidding, technical bids are revised after discussions before financial bids are invited. In two-bid system, technical and financial bids are submitted simultaneously
In two-stage bidding, technical bids are evaluated first, followed by evaluation of financial bids. In two bid system, both are evaluated by the Bid Evaluation Committee simultaneously
